notablePrerequisites: Murderous Redcap does not have any -1/-1 counters on it on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {C}{C}.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield.
Anafenza and Murderous Redcap trigger.
Resolve the Anafenza trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.
